title: dar-backup large-scale metrics
description: Read-only engineering evidence from the dar-backup large-scale test harness.

runs.description: One normalized row per large-scale harness result.

phases.description: Schema-v10 lifecycle timing and coarse resource-sample totals.

phase_process_memory.description: Per-process peak RSS grouped by harness lifecycle phase.

artifacts.description: Archive slice and PAR2 layout recorded by schema-v10 runs.

mutations.description: Synthetic DIFF and INCR workload mutations.

check_results.description: Flattened lifecycle-check evidence; value_json preserves the original JSON scalar.

bitrot_phases.description: Aggregate corruption and PAR2 repair evidence per archive tier.

bitrot_segments.description: Exact bit-rot regions and PAR2 block evidence.

engine_backup_runs.description: Optional dar-backup operational metrics copied from dar-backup-metrics.db.

engine_restore_samples.description: Optional sampled restore-test evidence copied from dar-backup-metrics.db.

recent-successful-runs.title: Recent successful runs
recent-successful-runs.description: Comparable workload, throughput, timing, and memory fields from completed runs.
recent-successful-runs.sql: select * from run_performance where passed = 1 and completed = 1 order by datestamp desc limit 50

failed-or-aborted-runs.title: Failed or aborted runs
failed-or-aborted-runs.description: Runs that did not complete successfully, including preflight aborts.
failed-or-aborted-runs.sql: select datestamp, schema_version, completed, exit_code, failure_count, aborted_phase, image_version from runs where passed = 0 or completed = 0 order by datestamp desc

large-scale.title: dar-backup large-scale test dashboard
large-scale.description: Run history, throughput, phase timing, memory, artifacts, and engine evidence.

latest-source-size.title: Latest successful source
latest-source-size.query: select round(source_bytes / 1073741824.0, 2) as source_gib from runs where passed = 1 and completed = 1 and source_bytes is not null order by datestamp desc limit 1

latest-overall-time.title: Latest successful lifecycle
latest-overall-time.query: select round(overall_elapsed_s / 60.0, 1) as overall_minutes from runs where passed = 1 and completed = 1 and overall_elapsed_s is not null order by datestamp desc limit 1

throughput-trend.title: FULL backup and restore throughput
throughput-trend.query: select substr(datestamp, 1, 10) || 'T' || replace(substr(datestamp, 12), '-', ':') as run_timestamp, 'FULL backup' as activity, full_throughput_mib_s as throughput_mib_s from run_performance where passed = 1 and full_throughput_mib_s is not null union all select substr(datestamp, 1, 10) || 'T' || replace(substr(datestamp, 12), '-', ':') as run_timestamp, 'Full restore' as activity, full_restore_throughput_mib_s as throughput_mib_s from run_performance where passed = 1 and full_restore_throughput_mib_s is not null order by run_timestamp

scale-versus-duration.title: Source scale versus FULL duration
scale-versus-duration.query: select source_gib, round(full_backup_seconds / 60.0, 2) as full_minutes, coalesce(dataset_id, 'unlabelled') as dataset from run_performance where passed = 1 and source_gib is not null and full_backup_seconds > 0 order by source_gib

latest-phase-duration.title: Latest run phase duration
latest-phase-duration.query: select phase_name, round(duration_s / 60.0, 2) as duration_minutes from phases where datestamp = (select max(datestamp) from runs where passed = 1 and completed = 1) and phase_name != 'overall' and duration_s is not null order by duration_s desc

memory-trend.title: Peak process RSS
memory-trend.query: select substr(datestamp, 1, 10) || 'T' || replace(substr(datestamp, 12), '-', ':') as run_timestamp, process_name, peak_rss_mib from memory_trends order by datestamp, process_name

archive-size-trend.title: Archive size by tier
archive-size-trend.query: select substr(datestamp, 1, 10) || 'T' || replace(substr(datestamp, 12), '-', ':') as run_timestamp, upper(tier) as tier, archive_gib from artifact_summary order by datestamp, tier

latest-engine-split.title: Latest operational FULL timing split
latest-engine-split.query: with latest as (select dar_duration_secs, verify_duration_secs, par2_duration_secs from engine_backup_runs where backup_type = 'FULL' and status = 'SUCCESS' order by run_started_at desc limit 1) select 'DAR' as component, round(dar_duration_secs, 2) as seconds from latest union all select 'Verification', round(verify_duration_secs, 2) from latest union all select 'PAR2', round(par2_duration_secs, 2) from latest

recent-runs.title: Recent runs
recent-runs.query: select datestamp, case when passed = 1 and completed = 1 then 'passed' else 'failed/aborted' end as result, source_gib, full_backup_seconds, full_throughput_mib_s, full_restore_seconds, full_restore_throughput_mib_s, overall_minutes, image_version from run_performance order by datestamp desc limit 12
